activationAuthority: FWA1 FrameworkActivation record (FWA1-AC7); this product is the erb row FWA1 reads as data

sources.read: as data: the resolved specs (name and exact version) of the lockfile's GEM sections
sources.selectionRule: the first gem present in the resolved specs decides; a later gem is never consulted once an earlier one is present. A present gem different from its exact ratified pin gives unsupported-version with that version, never a fallback to a later gem
sources.engineReleaseCheck: when actionview 8.1.4 selects erb.erubi-1.13.1, erubi must resolve to exactly 1.13.1; any other resolved version gives unsupported-version, and a missing erubi spec gives unavailable-engine-release, never an inferred pin
sources.identityRule: activation retains the selected exact resolved release and, for Action View, the exact engine release; profile identity comes from the ratified exact-release row, never releaseLine

sources.setting: frameworks.erb = on, naming one profile id from erb-version-lock.json
sources.rule: without a lockfile, only an explicit on that names a profile activates; on without a profile, or naming an unknown or unadmitted profile, activates nothing and reports why. With a lockfile, on never admits a release the lockfile resolves different from an exact ratified pin

states.result: off for every file; zero ERB work
active with provenance lockfile, the exact resolved release and selected exact-release profile

states.lockfile: present, gem differs from exact ratified pin
states.result: unsupported-version with the resolved version and reason

states.lockfile: present, none of the three gems

states.result: active with provenance explicit at the named exact-release profile and its ratified pins
not activated: on must name a profile

forbiddenSources.reason: an association says how a claimed file is hosted; it never activates the framework
a URL is not an installed release
a requirement is not a resolved version, and the Gemfile is never read

associations.gate: FWA1 erb active and an explicit configuration entry naming the file or glob as an HTML host (key bound by ERBP0)

associations.reason: an Action View variant spelling is not named by the ERB0 association decision; claiming it needs an amendment to this lock

associationOwner: ERBP0 owns file associations, document selectors and CLI globs (ERBP0-AC1, ERBP0-AC3); this table is their contract

vendoredFrameworks.rule: its admission is STIM0's vendored-version table; ERB treats its helpers as opaque Ruby
its admission is STIM0's vendored-version table; ERB treats its helpers as opaque Ruby
